question: Can the actual native auxiliary source or single original clock vertex produce the requested regular chiral hierarchy with singular orders 2,3,5, and what exact source coefficients remain to be derived?
resolved: For any normal complex 3x3 C and every complex h, the ordered singular values of C^T A(h)-A(h) C obey s1=s2+s3 exactly.
Any nonzero analytic family of this class has equal first two singular orders; regular canonical normalization preserves this exclusion of 2,3,5.
Any fixed diagonalizable C also excludes distinct first two analytic singular orders; actual Q,Qplus,Qminus have simple spectra.
A two-step Schur criterion characterizes orders 2,3,5 and the leading coefficients for a given canonical analytic vertex.
Nonlinear operator multiplicities can carry different poles but do not split components of a single invariant irrep; exact inherited Z16 elimination preserves SU3.
A nonnormal varying C has an explicit 2,3,5 scope-control witness; broader source vertices are not excluded.
kills: Searching all complex h in a single unitary or normal clock vertex can produce a regular asymptotic 2,3,5 hierarchy.
Replacing the clock by a single fixed diagonalizable compiler Q,Qplus,Qminus alone supplies the required hierarchy orders.
Exact state-preserving auxiliary elimination can split an unbroken SU3 family triplet merely by retaining memory.
assumptions: Normality of C in the physical positive family metric for the singular triangle, or fixed diagonalizability for the order-only corollary.
An independently source-derived analytic u family and positive regular kinetic matrices at u=0 for order statements.
Native invariant H and state, and well-defined covariant operators, for the isotypic and Z16 statements.
Target compiler formula is comparison data, not a measured native mass spectrum.
not_claimed: No general impossibility of TFPT, arbitrary source vertices, summed noncommuting contributions or singular/asymptotic source regimes.
No blanket exclusion of fitting one finite u value using freely chosen anisotropic regular kinetic matrices.
No derivation of physical chiral fields, their common source operator, u deformation or the actual vertex coefficients.
No original full W-tensor replay of the attached fourth-order charged-gap coefficients.
No complete physically admissible counterfamily preserving all P1/P2 conditions.
independent_review: INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md; separate bounded mathematical agent review, not external peer review
summary_de: Allgemeiner Singularwertsatz fuer alle komplexen Quellenvektoren ersetzt den endlichen Clock-Hierarchietest: sigma1=sigma2+sigma3. Daher keine normierungsfeste 2,3,5-Hierarchie in einem normalen Einzelvertex. Native Restwirkung bewahrt SU3. Der exakte Fuenf-Ordnungen-Test ist vollstaendig, seine geladenen Quellkoeffizienten bleiben unerzeugt.
